title: This Inevitable Ruin
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: A recent entry in the Dungeon Crawler Carl series, where a man and his former cat endure a deadly televised dungeon created by aliens. The stakes and absurdity keep escalating for a cast that has grown beyond the two original survivors.
readIf: you're caught up with the series and want more of its jokes, loot and increasingly cinematic battles.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, since the series builds heavily and this is not a starting point.

pairings.reason: More game-world spectacle and pop culture, if you want a lighter and less brutal take on the genre.
Also mocks the logic of a deadly, scripted setting for its characters, but in a tighter, wittier book.
Another fast, fun sci-fi with monsters, banter and cheerful absurdity.
